steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Classical conditioning (Pavlov): learning by association. A neutral stimulus becomes associated with an unconditioned stimulus, producing a conditioned response. Pavlov's dogs: bell (NS) paired with food (UCS) -> salivation (UCR). After conditioning: bell alone (CS) -> salivation (CR). Explains phobias and emotional responses. | Key Fact: Operant conditioning (Skinner): learning by consequences. Positive reinforcement: adding something pleasant to increase behaviour (reward). Negative reinforcement: removing something unpleasant to increase behaviour (taking painkillers removes pain). Punishment: adding something unpleasant to decrease behaviour.
